subject.title: feat(exec): macOS sandbox-exec wrapper for host process isolation

question: Should OpenClaw accept a per-call macOS `sandboxProfile` exec parameter, or should macOS process isolation be designed under the existing sandbox backend/config contract?
rationale: The PR defines a new security boundary and model-facing tool API, and automation cannot choose the permanent sandbox contract or threat model for maintainers.

options.title: Pause For Sandbox Design
options.body: Do not merge this branch until maintainers decide the macOS sandbox owner boundary and API shape.

options.title: Retarget Under Existing Sandbox
options.body: Ask for a rebased implementation that plugs into `agents.defaults.sandbox` and `host=sandbox` semantics with docs, audit/doctor coverage, and live proof.

options.title: Accept Experimental Per-call Surface
options.body: Maintainers can own a new `sandboxProfile` contract, but it needs explicit schema/docs compatibility and security proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Pause For Sandbox Design
recommendation.body: Do not merge this branch until maintainers decide the macOS sandbox owner boundary and API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined signal from sandbox backend history and prior sandbox architecture review context.
